label: miso 38 zonal reserves
definition: MISO 38 (KEEPER): miso-37 + LOCATIONAL reserve family per scope §6 (--miso-zonal-reserves): MISO-South zonal operating-reserve family, requirement = within-zone MSSC 3,953 MW (BPM-002 §3.3.2 zonal minimum, the 'pre-determined largest zonal event'), priced at the PUBLISHED Zonal Operating Reserve Demand Curve (BPM-002 §5.2.1.2 / Schedule 28-A: 20% @ $200, 70% @ $1,100, 10% @ $3,300 = VOLL - zonal reg proxy). Zero residual-fitted parameters. Gate 4 PARTIAL: the zonal family FIRES (reserve dual nonzero 266/287/875 h in 2023/24/25 — right year ordering, 2025-concentrated) but prices at re-dispatch opportunity cost ($8-21/MWh max), never at the curve steps: the LP always clears the requirement by re-dispatch, so the >$200 scarcity tail stays 0 h vs actual 30/37/88 and CT_PEAKER (5.0/8.4/8.8 TWh) / 2025 coal (212 TWh) are unchanged. Fit is unchanged vs miso-35 (mean LMP 28.65/26.06/34.74; duration-curve max lifts 54.5/62.0/70.4); keeper because strictly more structurally faithful (real co-opt + real zonal curve). Residual root cause is NOT missing reserve structure — perfect-foresight headroom; next levers: sub-shortage opportunity-cost band (per-gen ramp rows, memory-infeasible at plant scale) or the D6 per-hub LMP scoring once uploaded. GATE 2 SCORED vs D6 hub actuals (2026-07-02, docs/multi-iso/miso-zonal-gate2.md): PARTIAL/FAIL/PARTIAL. The South-below-Midwest sign is REAL (actual RT S-minus-Midwest -2.39/-3.20/-4.96 vs model -1.09/-0.55/-0.32) and RDT S->N binding hours carry real timing skill vs actual South-cheapest hours (lift 1.5-2.4x, precision to 92%) — but the five Midwest zone means are identical to the cent (pairwise mean-order agreement 10/5/5 of 15; the actual Indiana/East premium and the high-wind West discount, W-E -5 to -7, are absent), spread-duration is 1-2 orders under on every tier even vs DA, and the non-RDT CIL/CEL groups mostly bind DEGENERATELY (West CIL at cap 1152/238/661 h with $0 price effect). Root cause: LOLE island envelopes are adequacy-scale quantities, an order of magnitude above where real Midwest flowgates (MWEX, IN->MI, WUMS) price; next levers are published flowgate limits on L1-L6, the D1 Michigan split, and marginal-loss factors. Keeper standing unchanged (no more-faithful run exists; nothing tuned to the residual).
